This file is a TEST FIXTURE. Its content is invented and is NOT Ethiopian law.

Article 1. Short Title
This Proclamation may be cited as the Fictional Test Labour Proclamation.

Article 2. Notice of Termination
An employer who terminates an employment contract shall give the worker written notice
of termination stating the reasons and the date of termination.

Article 3. Severance Pay
A worker whose employment contract is terminated by the employer without good cause
is entitled to severance pay and compensation.

Article 4. Annual Leave
A worker is entitled to paid annual leave every year of service.
